convert_tf_checkpoint_to_pytorch: convert a TensorFlow ELECTRA checkpoint to a PyTorch model state dict file
load_tf_weights_in_electra: load TensorFlow checkpoint weights into an existing PyTorch ELECTRA model
build_electra_discriminator_model: build a PyTorch ELECTRA discriminator model from a TensorFlow checkpoint
build_electra_generator_model: build a PyTorch ELECTRA generator model from a TensorFlow checkpoint
run_electra_conversion_cli: run the ELECTRA TensorFlow to PyTorch checkpoint conversion via command line arguments
